title: Immediately after persuading Cal to go home, Lys's very next lines describe him as already back in the Vale and asleep ('He is really coming home' / 'He's home... watching him sleep'), while Cal is still standing three feet away at the scout line where the persuasion just happened.
where: Camp Gallows — The Scout Line / talk to Lys, 'ask after her brother'
